lead.purpose: Hero paragraph; section copy uses 17px in Quiet Grey.

title.purpose: Feature point names and list terms.

body-sm.purpose: Feature descriptions and list definitions, in Quiet Grey.

label.purpose: Release pill, facts line, footer, small button.

code.purpose: Inline code and kbd chips (Geist Mono).

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The system has no box-shadows; depth is tone steps plus white-alpha hairlines.

shadows.name: hero-glow
shadows.purpose: The single ambient App Blue glow behind the hero headline.

shadows.name: top-bar-blur
shadows.value: backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(14px) over 80% Night Ground

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Single easing for the rise and the button press.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Color, background and border transitions on hover.

motion.name: rise
motion.value: opacity 0 to 1, translateY(14px) to 0, blur(6px) to 0, .9s ease, 60ms stagger per sibling (max 6), once at 15% visibility
motion.purpose: Hero text and section copy entering. Content stays visible without JS or with reduced motion.

motion.name: hero-tilt
motion.value: perspective(1600px) rotateX(t*14deg) scale(1 - t*.04), t from 1 to 0 over the first 420px of scroll, rAF-throttled
motion.purpose: Hero clip tilts back and lies flat on scroll; disabled under reduced motion.

components.css: :host{--bg:#0c0d10;--raise:#14161a;--raise-2:#1b1d22;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.08);--line-2:rgba(255,255,255,.14);--text:#f4f5f7;--muted:#9da2ad;--faint:#7b808b;--accent:#7aa2f7;--on-accent:#0b1020;--sans:"Geist",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",system-ui,sans-serif;--mono:"Geist Mono",ui-monospace,"SF Mono",Menlo,monospace;--ease:cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)} .ds-list{margin:0;font-family:var(--sans);max-width:520px} .ds-list div{display:grid;grid-template-columns:170px minmax(0,1fr);gap:16px;padding:18px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--line)} .ds-list div:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line)} .ds-list dt{color:var(--text);font-weight:580;font-size:15px} .ds-list dd{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:15px;line-height:1.55} .ds-code{font:500 .86em var(--mono);background:var(--raise-2);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:5px;padding:.08em .38em;color:var(--text)}

narrative.overview:
The page is the category standard for developer tools, played straight and finished carefully, at the level of Zed and Linear. A centered headline, the real app as the hero, two feature sections, a short list, a download. Nothing is themed: the earlier split-flap board world was dropped because it was hard to read, and familiarity is now the point. The product's screenshots and the one linked map-and-grid clip carry the weight; the page around them stays near-black, quiet and legible.

Density is calm: a 1080px column with generous section spacing (120px), one accent color used sparingly, and depth from tone and hairlines rather than shadow. Motion is limited to two gestures: the hero clip tilts back and lies flat as you scroll, and text rises softly once as it enters. With reduced motion, everything is simply there, flat and still.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black ground with slightly raised surfaces; white-alpha hairlines do the structural work.
Geist for everything, Geist Mono only for code and keys; tight negative tracking on headings.
White primary button; the app's blue is the only accent.
Real app captures in thin bordered frames, no big shadows.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: App Blue is the only hue on the page. It marks small things (a tag, an icon stroke, focus) and never fills a button or a large area; the hero glow is its only ambient use.

rules.name: The White Button Rule
rules.body: The primary action is Paper White on Night Ground, brightening to pure white on hover. Emphasis comes from value, not hue.

rules.name: The Negative Tracking Rule
rules.body: Tracking tightens as size grows: -0.035em on display, -0.03em on headlines, -0.01em on the wordmark, about zero for body. Never letter-space small text or set it in uppercase.

rules.name: The Hairline, Not Shadow, Rule
rules.body: Separate and frame with a 1px white-alpha border (8% for dividers, 14% for objects). If something seems to need a shadow, it needs a stronger hairline or a tone step instead.

dos: Do keep App Blue to small marks: tags, icon strokes, focus, selection.
Do make the primary action the white button and everything secondary a ghost button.
Do frame every app capture with a 1px Hairline Strong border at 14px radius and nothing else.

Do use the single soft rise (14px up, 6px blur, 0.9s, ease cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), 60ms sibling stagger) for entering text, and nothing more; leave content visible without JS and under reduced motion.
Do use Lucide-style line icons (stroke 1.75, round caps) at 14-18px.
Do tighten heading tracking as size grows and balance heading wraps.
donts: Don't add box-shadows, glows on cards, or gradient fills; the hero's radial glow is the only ambient light.
Don't introduce a second accent hue or fill a button with App Blue.
Don't bring back themed devices (split-flap cells, display faces, board frames); the page must read as a familiar developer-tool site.
Don't use emoji, mockup devices or invented screenshots.
Don't set Faint Grey on surfaces lighter than Raised Slate, or use it for anything but fine print.
